name: caved-block-model
description: The block model plus its caved state, in the same comma-delimited shape the importer reads — so a run can be continued from where another one stopped.

layout.default_filename: the name given is used verbatim — no extension is appended

columns.name: HasCaved
columns.description: 1 if the block has caved, else 0.

columns.name: CavedPeriod
columns.description: Period at which the block caved. Note the spelling differs from the importer's `CavePeriod`.

columns.name: <block-model columns>
columns.description: Every column of the imported block model, in the exporter's own order.

notes: The column order is not the import order: the exporter puts PercK1 / PercK2 / PercVMR ahead of UCS.
source: Not in the manual — the command has no page. Read back from the file it writes.
